correctness.rationale: Conditional occupancy representation verified against exact finite Markov chains; negative covariance of missing-card indicators yields Var(U)≤EU and hence occupancy concentration. The descent error after replacing the missing tail by U/2 has mean-square O(1+EU)=o(n); the inversion Lehmer tail has conditional mean U(U−1)/4 and variance U(U−1)(2U+5)/72=o(n³) on average. Exact Gaussian variances 1/12 and 1/36 and Slutsky imply finite-shift laws. Divergent deficits force minus-infinity limits; subsequences establish necessity. Continuity of normal limits and the midpoint CDF difference yield the exact Kolmogorov profile. All claims quantify over arbitrary r_n/n→∞. No finite test is treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result completes the explicitly motivated intermediate-to-stationary transition for two classical random-to-top statistics, showing their scalar Gaussian-mixing thresholds differ by a factor of two and giving full finite-offset Gaussian and Kolmogorov profiles. It also resolves necessity (rather than merely sufficiency) via natural unseen-card scales and excludes the conjectural possibility of Gaussian mixing after arbitrary ω(n) steps. This is a complete and motivated boundary classification with a measurable statistical quantity, rather than a formal restatement of the source decomposition.
